purpose: Derive the exact off-shell epsilon^2 coefficient of the C-PHYS-M1 scalar-Maxwell bulk density under simultaneous covariant metric, scalar and U(1) perturbations. This closes the bulk matter metric-mixing algebra needed to combine WP1A with the WP1B gravity master, but does not close cap/boundary dynamics, diffeomorphism gauge reduction, a physical background, or any 4D observable map.

field_strength_expansion.index_rule: all raised indices and contractions in W0,W1,W2 use gbar_AB

exact_quadratic_density.pathwise_note: This is the epsilon^2 coefficient for the declared linear covariant field path; no background equations are imposed.

m1_specialization.lambda_and_Zsigma: not part of WP1C1; localized cap Hessian remains separate

consistency_limits.fixed_metric: p_AB=0 implies m1=m2=0, X1=2*u.v, X2=v^2, W1=2*Fbar.f, W2=f^2 and D2 exactly reduces to WP1A
consistency_limits.no_field_perturbations: varphi=0 and f_AB=0 leaves the pure metric second variation of the scalar-Maxwell background density
consistency_limits.no_background_flux: Fbar_AB=0 removes scalar-flux and metric-background-flux mixing but leaves the ordinary -Zbar*f^2/4 gauge Hessian
consistency_limits.constant_background_scalar: u_A=0 removes scalar-gradient metric mixing but not potential measure terms or Z_F-mediated flux mixing

independent_QA_contract.direct_local_density_test: For deterministic Lorentz-signature 6x6 backgrounds, evaluate the exact density sqrt(-det g(epsilon))*L_phiF(epsilon) at +/-epsilon and reconstruct the epsilon^2 coefficient by central difference; compare with D2 assembled from X0..X2, W0..W2, m1,m2 and frozen M1 derivatives.
independent_QA_contract.negative_F2_control: At least one test sample has Fbar^2<0 to prevent hidden Euclidean/positivity assumptions.
independent_QA_contract.WP1A_limit: Set p_AB=0 and compare D2 with the merged WP1A fixed-metric formula.
independent_QA_contract.field_strength_metric_expansion: Independently finite-difference W(epsilon)=g(epsilon)^AC g(epsilon)^BD F(epsilon)_AB F(epsilon)_CD and compare W1,W2.

what_remains_open: cap bending/embedding perturbation or globally justified fixed-interface gauge
diffeomorphism gauge control and S/V/T gauge-invariant variables
matter Delta_m observable-source definition and coupling
mu eta Sigma growth and lensing
ghost freedom, kinetic positivity, gradient stability and physical spectrum
forbidden_inferences: Do not interpret the local quadratic density as an on-shell physical perturbation action.
Do not impose Ebar_AB=0 in the gravity sector or use matter terms to claim cancellation before the complete parent Hessian and on-shell conditions are assembled.
Do not infer ghost freedom, positivity or stability from the exact algebraic matter Hessian.
Do not treat U(1) gauge invariance as diffeomorphism gauge closure.
Do not infer a 4D Poisson/slip/lensing/growth map.
Do not authorize solver execution or promote K1-D/K1-E.
